notablePrerequisites: Your opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments.
description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, creating at least six Treasure tokens.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Dockside Extortionist, scrying 1.
Activate five of the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {4}{B}.
Cast Corpse Dance with buyback by paying {4}{B}, returning Dockside Extortionist from your graveyard to the battlefield, and returning Corpse Dance to your hand.
Repeat from step 2.
